intro_en: Karoo Coast has no residences of its own, so this list matters. These places are fictional, like the university.
intro_zu: I-Karoo Coast ayinazo izindawo zayo zokuhlala, ngakho lolu hlu lubalulekile. Lezi zindawo ziqanjiwe, njengenyuvesi.
note_en: Not on the list? Don't pay anything. Ask the Housing Desk first.
note_zu: Ayikho ohlwini? Ungakhokhi lutho. Buza eDeskini Lezindawo Zokuhlala kuqala.

intro_en: On a real campus this is the official list of result codes. Every university uses its own codes: these are examples, like Karoo Coast itself.
intro_zu: Ekhampasi yangempela lolu uhlu olusemthethweni lwamakhodi emiphumela. Inyuvesi ngayinye isebenzisa amakhodi ayo: lawa ayizibonelo, njengeKaroo Coast uqobo.
note_en: A supp usually needs a final mark just below the pass mark, often 40–49%. It is written within weeks, so check the date now.
note_zu: Isivivinyo esengeziwe ngokuvamile sidinga amamaki okugcina angaphansi nje kwamamaki okuphasa, imvamisa angu-40–49%. Sibhalwa emasontweni ambalwa, ngakho hlola usuku manje.

intro_en: On a real campus this opens the university's own application site. Karoo Coast University is fictional, so these steps are an example.
intro_zu: Ekhampasi yangempela lokhu kuvula isayithi lezicelo lenyuvesi uqobo. I-Karoo Coast University iqanjiwe, ngakho lezi zinyathelo ziyisibonelo.
note_en: Apply only on the official site. Nobody can apply for you for a fee, and nobody can sell you a place.
note_zu: Faka isicelo kuphela kusayithi esemthethweni. Akekho ongakufakela isicelo ngenkokhelo, futhi akekho ongakuthengisela indawo.
